NEUTRAL OUTPUT CONTRACT
Produce JSON object with:
1. schema_version:1
2. target:{name,identity,objective,rules}: strings. Rules are complete TARGET-ONLY operational manual sufficient for solver action generation; never mention museum/source/mapping or source field names. Distinct target task should have meaningful target mechanics, not just substitute labels. Explain why target goals require choosing actions from current state. Provide target names for all mechanics, attributes, constraints, approvals, provenance, neighborhood inheritance, atomic actions.
3. correspondence: prose explaining operational equivalence, differences in task identity, and limitations (not sent to solver).
4. key_map: bijective JSON map from EVERY following source key to a distinct chosen target key. Keys: id,title,home,medium,restricted,reservation,notes,creation,sequence,event_id,actor,gallery_id,slot,due,approval_id,name,department,slots,rules,version,latest_due,allowed_media,loan_id,until,exception,op,to_gallery_id,text,kind,context_id,tx_id,expected_revision,rule_versions,operations,question,scope,loan_ids,allowed_ops,referents,revision,loans,galleries,approvals,records,occupancy,occupied,visibility,authorized_loan_count,authority,missing_ids,next_after_sequence,order. Keys must be valid lowercase snake_case; avoid source-domain terms in target vocabulary. You may retain neutral technical keys only if genuinely natural.
5. id_prefixes: bijection of source identifier prefix strings loan:,gal:,rule:,approval:,dept: to distinct target prefix strings ending ':'; suffixes are retained losslessly. Opaque context and transaction identifiers are untouched.
6. enum_map: bijective map from source tokens reserve,transfer,cancel,annotate,create,transaction,clarify,metal,paper,stone,textile,medium,empty,visible,restricted,host_stored_only,creation_desc,creation_asc to unique target tokens. Key names and enum tokens may differ. JSON null/bools/ints/date strings retained. Only exact token values are transformed, not arbitrary prose. Operation token target and field names in rules must match your maps.
7. neighborhood: {source_unit:'gallery',target_unit:string,principle:string}; explain induced containment and invariant locality, not an independent writable target database.
8. roundtrip: text covering decode target operation maps, stable ID mapping, free text unchanged, and preserved provenance.

Implementation will consume artifact as data without repairing it, recursively rename recognized keys, map exact enum strings and identifier prefixes EXCEPT in protected free-text and opaque fields (title,text,notes,name,actor,event_id,question,context_id,tx_id), omit legacy target_id fields, and leave other values intact. Solver will receive only target manual and encoded scoped records, context, occupancy and target-language goal; not correspondence or source maps. Runtime will decode chosen target operations and pass to source invariant validator. It will accept target operation list or target clarify record; host injects trusted transaction envelope from issuance. Rules should explicitly tell solver response is JSON with target key for operations containing target operations, or target kind=clarify enum and target question key. Do not embed tests or source examples. State any mapping limitations honestly; source schema is human-designed, target choice and operational mapping are yours.
